title: Shared ledger definitions
description: Ids, text, limits, enums and the server's stamp, shared by every event schema. Lengths count code points. The hand validator (packages/format/src/ledger-shape.ts) gives the same verdict.

nodeNumber.description: A card: its number on the board (from 1, in draw order, never reused); on a ledger line, its ledger number, unique in the project.

nodeNumbers.description: Two or more distinct node numbers, each once.

cards.description: The cards a retire took off the board, by ledger number, each once.

key.description: Retry key, per agent across the project.

mode.description: How a container lays out its cards: `grid`, `flow` (follows the links), `lanes`, `radial`, `column` (top to bottom in card order) or `row` (left to right in card order).

lineMode.description: A mode as a line or a sent item may name it: one of `mode`, or `list`, which `notList` refuses with words saying it is `column` now.

notList.description: `list` is now `column` (top to bottom in card order); `row` runs left to right, `flow` follows the links.

widths.description: How wide a container's cards are: `match`, every card in a column as wide as the column's widest card, or `own`, each card its own width. Left out, the container's mode decides: `match` for `grid` and `column`, `own` for `flow`, `row`, `lanes` and `radial`.

direction.description: Which way a `flow` container runs: `across`, left to right, or `down`, top to bottom. Left out: `across`. The person's choice wins.

actDirection.description: The person's flow direction: `across`, `down`, or `auto`, which clears their choice at that level and gives back the agent's.

skin.description: How the board looks: `default` or `command-lens`. A skin changes how nodes look and where their controls sit, never what they do. Left out: `default`.

iconName.description: A node's icon: a built-in name (list_icons names them), or one from the project's icon library, `x-` then what it shows.

libraryIconName.description: A name in the project's icon library: `x-`, then what it shows, in lowercase letters, digits and `-`; the file is `<name>.svg` in the library.

iconHash.description: The SHA-256 of a library icon's file, in lowercase hex.

tone.description: A node's tone: a palette name, or a hue, a whole number from 0 to 359, the OKLCH hue angle (not text). The board derives the tints from it so contrast passes in light and dark; the kind keeps its own colour.
tone.$comment: packages/format TONES, TONE_HUE_MAX; was: api.md 184, D-100 3

anyOf.description: A hue: the OKLCH hue angle, in whole degrees.

timeline.description: A node's date, in one of four forms, each a precision: `2026`, `2026-10`, `2026-10-13` or `2026-10-13T14:30`. A time is as written, with no zone. The nodes of a container that have one share its timeline.
timeline.$comment: packages/format timeline.ts TIMELINE_PATTERN, isTimeline: the code also checks that the day exists in its month (leap years too), which a pattern can't say; was: api.md 190, D-105

timelineSent.description: A node's date as an agent may send it: text of up to 40 characters, or a whole number for a year. The board stores it in one of the four forms of `timeline` or refuses it.
timelineSent.$comment: packages/format timeline.ts normaliseTimeline, TIMELINE_MAX; write-board.ts normalises before the schema is checked; was: api.md 190, D-105

askContext.description: What the agent was given with an ask: the node, the node with its board, or the board's own chat session.

noteKind.description: What a person's note asks for: a comment, or more context

appWidth.description: An app panel's width in px.

appHeight.description: An app panel's height in px.

appHash.description: The SHA-256 of an app's code (its manifest, then its tools file), in lowercase hex, as list_apps gives it.

appRef.description: Which app an app card shows, and the size of its panel. Left out, the size is the manifest's `size`, else the default (docs/specification/apps.md § Panel size).

id.description: The app's folder name in the open ledger's `apps/`.

w.description: The panel's width in px; the card adds its padding.

nodeRef.description: A card: its number on this board, or `{ key }` of the item that drew it.

key.description: The key of the item that drew it.

stamp.description: What the server writes on every stored line. A sent body never sets these.

v.description: The ledger format of the line: 22. A ledger in an older format is migrated before it is read (`npm run ledger:migrate`); one in a newer format opens read-only.

seq.description: The line's position in the ledger.

at.description: When the server wrote the line.

agent.description: The agent that wrote the line: an agent id. An agent's line with none was drawn in format 2, before agents had ids, and was migrated.

person.description: The person's name, written only once a board has more than one person.

from.description: Whose words an imported note or reply holds, from the board the file came from (point 617): the person's (`by: person`), or an agent's, by its id and label there. The line's own `by` is who imported it.
from.$comment: One optional field on an imported `comment` act or `reply` line; no format bump, it rides ledger 22.

by.description: Who wrote the words first: `person` or `agent`.

agent.description: The agent that wrote them first: its id on the ledger they came from.

stampAgent.$comment: Kept apart from `stamp` because ajv only credits the fields of a referenced schema whose own `if` is dynamic when that schema passes, so one bad agent would make every stamp field read as unknown; `stamp` stays static and always vouches for them.

agent.description: The agent that wrote the line: an agent id.
